purpose: One evidence-gated route from working platform source to touchable hardware, human-friendly experiences and approved artist-centered participation; not a claim of humanoid AI or a finished operating system.
sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

separateAxes.warning: The four progression milestones DO NOT rename or replace four package tiers, four source modules, escalation levels or seven visual planes.

stages.humanMeaning: The machine foundation boots, builds and exposes deterministic interfaces.
requiredProof: exact current source SHA and passing source audit
target-specific host/kernel separation and rollback notes
reproducible boot or Android build log when claiming binary readiness
stages.next: Run the new manifest audit, then separately build only the intended Linux/Android candidate. Preserve Android GKI and supported Linux host kernel. No destructive boot or flash operation.

stages.humanMeaning: The machine meets a real person through a responsive, installable Samsung or desktop interface.
requiredProof: real APK source/manifest/package identity and persistent owner signer match
actual signed APK digest, versionCode, ABI, SDK and signature verification
Samsung launch, back navigation, tap, rotate, resume and upgrade without data loss
one-click accessibility/clear error and offline fallback
stages.next: Do not confuse Godot beta with separate campaignpreview package; register companion source in a scoped candidate, use protected signing without regenerating owner keys, then collect physical Samsung receipts.

stages.humanMeaning: Human-centered voice, art, comic, accessible workflows and gentle interaction over machine capabilities.
requiredProof: real mobile/desktop touch and keyboard focus test
live host GUI mount or independently installed offline companion test
original character assets with provenance or visibly labeled prototypes
Babylon/Godot opt-in and Live2D fallback without claiming unsupported rig
stages.next: Review original chibi/Lum visuals with Yume role in chat, then validate real seven-plane viewport and inspect CSP/browser on Android. Do not treat bridge data as a mounted widget.

stages.humanMeaning: Human-owned creation, family-friendly accessibility, artist credit, informed collaborator consent and fundraising-first community.
requiredProof: approved human authorship, contributor and likeness consent, and license ledger
protected private originals and independently approved public derivatives
creative workflow usability and meaningful artist control
fundraising copy accurately says development support, not a finished product for sale
Professor review of exact public artifact and partner/social permissions
stages.next: Finalize rights-safe review drafts and real artist-controlled creative workflows. Make a separate approved public funding release only after verified consent and artifact checks.
